requirements.text: Platform access requires an explicit seeded platform role with admin.access; no self-service path grants it.

An authorized administrator can suspend or restore another account and manage platform roles only after a confirmation identifies the target account and action; last-super-admin protections remain mandatory.
An administrator cannot self-suspend, self-demote, or remove the last super administrator.
The operations provisioning command grants the seeded super-admin role rather than a user boolean.
Immutable super-admin and support roles receive the approved platform permission sets.
User management exposes status, verification, platform roles, workspace membership metadata, restoration, and broadcasts.

acceptanceCriteria.text: All administration entry and mutation routes check explicit platform permissions.
The last super administrator cannot be suspended, deleted, or stripped of platform access.
User records collapse to labelled cards on mobile without exposing tenant-private data.

observedBehaviors: Users appear in a dense table with account, status, role, and usage metadata.
User records collapse into labelled mobile cards.
The mobile header replaces the desktop sidebar.
Roles are listed with permission/member metadata and row actions.

implementationEvidence.description: The limited /admin interface requires target/action confirmation before suspension, restoration, administrator grants/revocations, and plan assignment. A synthetic account completed suspend/restore and grant/revoke round trips; an ordinary user received 403 from /admin. Immutable role provisioning and last-super-admin protections remain outstanding.
implementationEvidence.reference: Disposable review app http://localhost:8101/admin; confirmation workflows at 1440x900 and ordinary-user access check at /admin.

implementationEvidence.description: At 390x844, /admin displayed labelled account cards without horizontal document overflow. Account metadata remains visible; private tenant content and visitor data are absent.
